name: io.github.bangca85/cardloom-mcp
title: Cardloom
description: Reviewed, git-backed engineering knowledge base for coding agents, served over MCP.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWLEDGE_STORE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Folder that holds the cards (a git repository). Defaults to ~/.cardloom/knowledge-store.

environmentVariables.name: INDEX_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path of the derived SQLite index. Defaults to ~/.cardloom/index.db.
